title: Supplied Cosmic_dust narwhal · left and rare two-tusk exterior studies
author: Cosmic_dust
delivery: Bundled supplied artist GLB derivative, uniform display transform, repaired same-artist eyes and capped tusks. Source body and UV retained; separate original regional materials and finite posterior bending and whole-body posture studies.
biology: Artist exterior, qualitatively compared with FAO and primary narwhal references. Age/sex, local proportions, pigment, tissue and optics remain unmeasured. Typical single-left-erupted-tusk selection is not universal.
changes: PBR material compatibility conversion; source body and all four embedded images unchanged; separate right tusk omitted, left tip capped; two source eye meshes closed, simplified and two redundant wedge faces removed. Runtime normalized placement, eye materials, bounded luminance/desaturation and approximate dielectric highlight, posterior flexion and supine orientation are disclosed derivatives. No source texture pixels changed. v654 runtime derivative bakes orientation, deinterleaves cloned attributes, splits the oral commissure, attaches original oral surfaces and replaces the active painted body field with original continuous gray/white vertex pigment and normal/roughness maps. The original delivered GLB and embedded image bytes are unchanged; the active surface differs.
